_comment: OPT-IN FAILING FIXTURE. Run it with: node run.js --traces traces.buggy.json  (add --gate to see a red release gate + non-zero exit). These rows reproduce the classic tool-calling failures — a lookalike-tool collision (send_imessage vs send_email), a mis-extracted parameter (Liked Songs -> Top Hits, 30min -> 60min), and a wrong-money refund ($40 to Jane logged as $400 to John). The safety gate catches the money one before it fires. In production these rows come from an agent_tool_calls export (user_message -> tool -> args, logged BEFORE execution).
